name: canvas-bulk-grading
tagline_zh: 还在逐份点开学生作业？用 rubric 批量打分，先干跑预览再执行，改完还能跑代码验证——省下的是周五晚上的命。
tagline_en: Stop clicking through student submissions. Grade in bulk with rubrics, preview every change in dry-run, then.
desc_en: Bulk grading workflows for Canvas LMS assignments using rubrics. Covers single grading, batch grading, and code execution strategies with safety-first dry runs.
why_zh: 同类工具只会批量提交分数，它却把「干跑预览」和「代码执行验证」焊进流程，让误批归零，敢对全班下手。
why_en: Unlike tools that just push grades, this one bakes in dry-run previews and code-execution checks, so you can batch-grade with.
